messages:
julia_research: Quick sanity ping: onboarding run for gamma48k-int4 showed consistent phase "tilt" and small token misorders after 16.8k tokens when using the new interleaved-compact remap (we call it "fold-remap"). minimal flags below.
kai_infra: paste the serve flags + image tag and which cluster.
julia_research: serve: `./serve --model gamma48k-int4 --prefill=interleaved-compact --fold-remap=true --prefill-stride=3 --quant=int4_chunked --meta-compress=true` image: gh/onboard/gamma-int4:fold-3 cluster: ded-2
leah_eval: short diff sample (fp16 vs int4):
```
FP16: "At 08:00 UTC on April 10, the committee finalized the amendment."
INT4: "At 08:00 UTC April 10 the committee finalized amendment the."
```
matt_platform: Looks like punctuation drop + local reorder around numeric/date span. Any KV checksums or index maps?
julia_research: kv-checksum: fp16=0xabc123ff, int4(fold-remap)=0xdef456aa, int4(no-fold)=0xabc123ff. kv-map-diff shows slot folding shifts at multiples of tile=512.
leah_eval: rope-tilt-check --compare fp16 int4 --window 18000 reports max tilt 0.0030 rad at pos 16896 which aligns with where errors start. small goldset perp: fp16=6.8 int4(fold)=10.9 int4(no-fold)=7.1
kai_infra: Hypothesis: fold-remap applies logical->physical mapping before RoPE slope assignment. Should remap first then compute pos multipliers. Add a quick debug: `export DEBUG_ROPE_REMAP=1` to log mapping order.
julia_research: enabled debug and re-run; logs show pos multipliers computed on pre-remap indices. pushing a quick branch to flip order.
matt_platform: For canary safety, disable fold-remap on incoming canaries until we have a unit test proving mapping idempotence. open revert if goldset drops.
ci-bot: build 19421: gh/onboard/gamma-int4:fold-3 pushed to staging :white_check_mark:
julia_research: I'll run canary with fold-remap off, run rope-tilt + 20-anchor goldset, and post diffs. if that fixes, PR title will be "fix(kv): compute RoPE after remap for interleaved compaction (fold-remap)"
leah_eval: please include a tiny unit test: synthetic kv with stride>1, assert rope multipliers equal baseline after remap. that'll prevent regressions.
matt_platform: agree. prioritize canary revert if perf/quality drop appears. thanks all.
